name: igor
description: IGOR: a robot voice for Claude Code on Linux/X11. Tap Right Ctrl to talk, Right Ctrl + Space to translate, and IGOR answers aloud.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: Deepgram language code of what you say (en, fr, es, de...).

keyterms.title: Words to recognise
keyterms.description: Comma-separated names or jargon Deepgram should favour. 'Igor' is the default so it is not heard as 'I car'.

translateTo.title: Translate into
translateTo.description: Language name for Right Ctrl + Space (e.g. English, French, Spanish).

speakReplies.title: Speak replies
speakReplies.description: IGOR reads Claude's answer aloud when you sent the question by voice.

voiceId.title: Cartesia voice id
voiceId.description: Cartesia voice id. Empty = Henry, a flat male voice that suits the robot effect.

micDevice.title: Microphone (ALSA)
micDevice.description: 'auto' prefers a USB microphone; otherwise an ALSA device such as plughw:1,0 (see `arecord -l`).

speakerDevice.title: Speaker (ALSA)
speakerDevice.description: ALSA playback device; 'default' is the system default.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python 3 used for the helper scripts (standard library only).

envFile.title: Env file with the API keys
envFile.description: Optional path to a file containing DEEPGRAM_API_KEY=... and CARTESIA_API_KEY=... lines, read by the helpers (never printed). Alternative to the key options or your shell environment.

chordKeycode.title: Translate chord key (X11 keycode)
chordKeycode.description: Pressed while the dictation key is held. 65 = Space.

deepgramApiKey.title: Deepgram API key
deepgramApiKey.description: Speech-to-text. Or set DEEPGRAM_API_KEY in your environment.

cartesiaApiKey.title: Cartesia API key
cartesiaApiKey.description: Text-to-speech (optional). Or set CARTESIA_API_KEY in your environment.

voiceEngine.title: IGOR's engine
voiceEngine.description: machine = a real formant synthesizer (eSpeak NG, local, like 90s computers; speaks the language of its voice), cartesia = a human-like cloud voice with an optional robot effect.

machineVoice.title: Machine voice (eSpeak NG)
machineVoice.description: eSpeak NG voice name, language and variant (en-us+klatt4, fr+klatt, en+m3...). Replies are condensed and translated into this voice's language before being spoken.

machineRate.title: Machine voice rhythm: words per minute
machineRate.description: eSpeak words per minute at speed 1.0. Lower is slower and more deliberate.

machineWordGap.title: Machine voice rhythm: pause between words
machineWordGap.description: Extra silence between words, in tens of milliseconds (0 = none).

voiceStyle.title: IGOR's voice
voiceStyle.description: For the cartesia engine only: robot (buzzing 90s computer), soft (grit only) or plain (no effect).

voiceSpeed.title: IGOR's speaking speed
voiceSpeed.description: 0.5 (slow) to 2.0 (fast); 1.0 is the voice as synthesized. Some voices talk fast: lower it if you cannot follow.

showBand.title: Show IGOR above the prompt
showBand.description: A one-line band showing what IGOR is doing.

ringSound.title: Ring when it is your turn
ringSound.description: Play an old telephone bell when Claude has finished and is waiting for you (the band always shows a ringing phone).

phrases.title: IGOR's own lines
phrases.description: Short spoken lines of IGOR's: a greeting at the start, a line when it did not hear you.
